mentions.name: intim-dnd
mentions.description: This tool lets Dungeon Masters run immersive tabletop Dungeons & Dragons sessions using a USB camera and projector pointed at a table. Players interact with the projected game through gestures detected by a hand-tracking deep learning model — picking up and moving characters, inspecting stats by hovering, and changing weapons — while the DM can generate graphics on the fly with generative models. It includes built-in auto-calibration of the camera by projecting points and registering them with the camera.
mentions.audience: Dungeon Masters running Dungeons & Dragons sessions and their players
mentions.source_excerpt: I attached a USB camera to a projector pointing at a table and made a tool for DMs to organize immersive Dungeons and Dragons games where players can interact with the game using gestures through a hand tracking deep learning model and the DM can generate graphics on the fly using generative models.
